text:
maria: Quick note from today's lab — confusion in Batch > Preview > Export. Screenshot + Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz9999/vecs-export maria: The export CTA says "Export vectors" but helper text calls out "download CSV". Users weren't sure if export meant CSV, JSON, or pushing to the API. devon: Seen this too. Suggest we make primary explicit: "Download CSV" and add a chevron for "Other formats" (JSON, Parquet). jamie: UX nit: the export modal shows a truncated vector cell with "[0.123, 0.45..]" — testers wanted to know which metadata columns are included before downloading. lina: Accessibility: whatever we do, we need SR-friendly copy. E.g. aria-labels like "Download CSV, dropdown: choose format" and an aria-live region for progress updates. maria: Proposed changes: - Primary CTA -> "Download CSV" + small dropdown: JSON / Parquet - Modal heading -> "Export selected vectors" and body -> "Download selected vectors as a CSV (id, embedding, chosen metadata)." - Add "View columns" link in modal that opens a small, keyboard-focusable dialog listing columns. - Rename density control to "Row density" (Comfortable / Compact / Condensed) + SR hint: "affects table spacing". aqil: Copy tweak: replace "selected queries" with "selected vectors" across flow. I'll send a tiny PR. jamie: Implementation note: for large selections (>200 rows) suppress inline column preview and show link only, to avoid layout thrash. lina: aria-live examples:
Preparing CSV...
then update to "Download ready". Also announce format chosen: "Format: CSV". designbot: Reminder: changing format labels affects telemetry. Update event key export_format and ensure values are stable. Docs: https://redwood.infra/docs/telemetry/export-events maria: OK will update Figma with copy + a11y notes and schedule 15m sync tomorrow 10:30am. Assignments: @aqil copy, @jamie dropdown/preview behavior, @lina a11y checks. Thanks! :thumbsup:
